name: Necromancer: Transfer Life keeps channelling and heals only the Raised minions (#1442)
contract: Transfer Life 801530 (SkillLineAbility 760265, granted at level 18) reads 'Channel life into your Raised minions within $a1 yds for $d, healing them for $801545s1% of their maximum health plus ... every $t2 sec.' Spell.dbc: SPELL_ATTR1_IS_CHANNELED | IS_SELF_CHANNELED | EXCLUDE_CASTER, SpellDuration 1 = 10000 ms, both effects APPLY_AURA on TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ALLY within SpellRadius 9 = 20 yd (MaxAffectedTargets 5); effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL every 1000 ms on 801545 (HEAL_PCT 5% plus HEAL on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY). 801545 carries TargetAuraSpell 807177 'Raise Marker' ('Dummy aura for necro minions'), which no server path applies, so the first tick's 801545 fails SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AURASTATE and Spell::prepare then ends the triggering periodic aura and sends a channel update of 0: the reported channel that stops before its first tick and heals nothing. Two Raised Lesser Skeletal Warriors (Raise 500970, 1 Life Force each) must both carry the channel aura 3.5 s into the 10 s channel, the channel must still be running, and each of the three 1 s ticks must heal both minions (six 801545 heals, at least four asserted). A party member (an Undead Mage) standing beside the caster is a friendly unit inside the 20 yd area but not a Raised minion, so it must neither carry the channel aura nor be healed.

steps.label: Let login and the Life Force aura settle
Put a second player in the caster's party
Raise the first Lesser Skeletal Warrior
SETUP: one Lesser Skeletal Warrior is raised
Raise the second Lesser Skeletal Warrior
SETUP: two Lesser Skeletal Warriors are raised
Let the minions take their formation places
Wound the party member so a heal would show
SETUP: the Transfer Life channel starts
The channel is still running 3.5 s into its 10 s duration
Both Raised minions still carry the caster's Transfer Life aura
Every tick heals the Raised minions (2 minions x 3 ticks)
CONTROL: the party member is not a Transfer Life target
CONTROL: the party member is never healed by Transfer Life
